What Is Powder Coating?

Powder coating is a dry finishing process. Thermoset powder is sprayed onto clean, grounded metal with an electrostatic gun, then cured in an oven at roughly 180 to 200 °C. The heat melts the powder into one continuous film that is harder and more chip-resistant than most liquid paints, with no solvents released.

As a powder coating company GTA businesses rely on for repeat work, we focus on what decides how long a finish lasts: surface preparation, correct film thickness and a full cure. Our guides on what is powder coating and powder coating vs wet paint go deeper.

Shop Capabilities

Our cure oven accepts parts up to 23 ft long, 9 ft wide and 9 ft high, and our lifting equipment handles single pieces up to 6,000 lb. Large frames and chassis are coated whole. Every batch is checked for adhesion to ASTM D3359 and dry film thickness to ASTM D7091. Full specifications are on our large part powder coating page.
Our Powder Coating Process
Every order follows the same five steps. Our step-by-step powder coating process guide explains each one in detail.
Quote & Inspect
We review your photos, drawings or parts, then confirm price, colour and ready date in writing.
Strip & Blast
Old coatings, rust and mill scale are removed, leaving a clean, profiled surface the powder can grip.
Pretreat & Mask
Parts are degreased and phosphate-treated, and threads, holes and contact faces are plugged or taped.
Coat & Cure
Powder is applied electrostatically, then cured at about 180 to 200 °C into one hard, continuous film.
Inspect & Hand Over
We test adhesion and thickness, check colour and coverage, then pack parts for pickup or delivery.

blocks.q: Where is Koojo Custom Powder Coating located?
blocks.a: Our shop is at 10874 Steeles Ave E, Milton, ON L9T 2X8, near Highways 401 and 407. Drop-off hours are Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 5 PM. Call (905) 876-7060 before bringing large parts.

blocks.q: Do you work with businesses or individuals?
blocks.a: Both. Most of our volume comes from fabricators, manufacturers and contractors on repeat orders, but we also coat one-off parts for car owners, restorers and homeowners.

blocks.q: How do I get a quote?
blocks.a: Send photos, sizes, quantity and your finish through our powder coating quote form, or call us. We reply with a written price, colour and ready date.
Yes. Koojo is certified by the Absolute Bureau of Certification, and every batch is tested for adhesion and film thickness. Our certification page explains our powder coating quality assurance.
